This was a retrospective clinical study of 44 metastatic colorectal cancer patients who received FOLFIRI (5-Fluorouacil + Folinic acid + irinotecan) first-line therapy alone or with bevacizumab. It assessed the relationship between PIK3CA mutation status in primary tumors and response to irinotecan-based first line therapy, as measured by PFS.
